text:
The target query counts as addressed when its key words appear in the rendered text of the draft. That is a presence test, not a judgment of how well the question is answered. The check also says nothing about truth: it measures whether a draft answers its brief, not whether what it says is correct.

TextOS's product record explicitly forbids describing this check as a promise that the content is useful. Whether an article is good for its reader remains a human judgment. A pass means the draft did what the brief asked; it does not mean the brief asked for the right things.
